fields.name: folder
fields.label: PDF folder
fields.hint: The folder to look for .pdf files in, on the TF card and in the frame's internal storage; empty for all of them.

fields.name: file
fields.label: File to open
fields.hint: A file to open once, as "<storage>:<path>": what the Files app sends.

fields.name: fullScreen
fields.label: Full screen
fields.hint: The whole glass for the page: no bar of the frame's layout around it.

pdfViewer.name: PDF viewer
pdfViewer.description: PDF files from the frame's card: a library, pages drawn to fit the screen (or its width, a part at a time), the bookmarks, go to a page by number, and each document kept where you left it.
